name: Arcade Learning Environment
description: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) is a platform and evaluation methodology for general, domain-independent AI agents. It provides an interface to hundreds of Atari 2600 games, serving as a rigorous testbed for reinforcement learning, model learning, planning, imitation learning, transfer learning, and intrinsic motivation research.
typical_sota_score: 1000+ average score or 20–30% human-normalized performance, depending on the reporting protocol
reputation: Widely adopted as a standard benchmark for reinforcement learning and general AI agent evaluation.
notes: Includes over 55 Atari 2600 games; software and benchmark agents are publicly available.
